prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent animation sprite sheet, not a poster. Create ONE high-resolution 2048x2048 square RGBA PNG with EXACTLY 16 full-body sequential animation frames in a perfectly regular FOUR column by FOUR row grid. Read left to right then top to bottom. Every cell is exactly 512x512; place each character completely inside its own cell with at least 30px transparent gutters. No contact between cells.
Input reference: the supplied Finn sheet is the character identity and rendering style reference, not the target poses. Preserve this exact friendly bespectacled young male mascot: large curly brown hair, black round glasses, warm skin, red cardigan with black buttons, white collared shirt, charcoal trousers, cream sneakers with yellow soles, yellow folder held against chest by the same arm throughout. Same proportions, facial identity, outfit, folder design and high-quality dimensional cartoon rendering. Static camera and lighting. Full body including both shoes in EVERY cell. Keep character scale and foot baseline identical across all frames. Actual transparent alpha background, no floor, no shadows, no labels, no numbers, no grid lines, no extra props.
Animation: A warm, energetic greeting. Frames 1–4: from relaxed rest, torso leans toward viewer and free hand rises smoothly beside his head. Frames 5–8: open palm makes one broad outward wave arc with a wrist turn, cheerful eyebrows and smile. Frames 9–12: one inward wave arc. Frames 13–16: hand lowers smoothly, weight and head settle back to exact initial relaxed stance. Use counter-motion in head and shoulders; feet stay planted. Frame 16 must match frame 1.
These are closely-spaced keyframes of ONE coherent continuous gesture. Draw visible progressive intermediate limb positions instead of repeated identical stills. Match face and clothing details across frames. Do not redraw the character differently each frame. Preserve generous arcs and appealing anticipation/follow-through while avoiding extreme deformation. The first and last frames are the same neutral stance, allowing a seamless loop. All sixteen frames are required.
